```{r}
#| label: setup-env
pacman::p_load(data.table, tidyverse, here, glmmTMB, fs, modelsummary, pandoc)

here::i_am("scripts/L3/309_SUPP_precipitation.qmd")

# directories
dir_304_final_data <- here("data", "L3", "304_final_data")
dir_305_models <- here("data", "L3", "305_models")
dir_309_precip <- here("data", "L3", "309_precip_analysis")
fs::dir_create(dir_309_precip)
```

# Read data

```{r}
#| label: read-data
diurn_on_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304d_diurn_on_final_50.rds"))
diurn_ev_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304e_diurn_ev_final_50.rds"))
noc_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304f_noc_final_50.rds"))
```


```{r}
#| label: prep-data
# Onset diurnal
diurn_on_50$alan_sc <- scale(log1p(diurn_on_50$avg_rad))
diurn_on_50$cld_sc <- scale(diurn_on_50$sunrise_cloud_cover_percent)
diurn_on_50$family <- as.factor(diurn_on_50$family)
diurn_on_50$precip_sc <- scale(diurn_on_50$sunrise_precipitation_mm)

# Onset cessation
diurn_ev_50$alan_sc <- scale(log1p(diurn_ev_50$avg_rad))
diurn_ev_50$cld_sc <- scale(diurn_ev_50$sunset_cloud_cover_percent)
diurn_ev_50$family <- as.factor(diurn_ev_50$family)
diurn_ev_50$precip_sc <- scale(diurn_ev_50$sunset_precipitation_mm)

# Nocturnal
noc_50$alan <- log1p(noc_50$avg_rad)
noc_50$alan_sc <- scale(noc_50$alan)
noc_50$cld_sc <- scale(noc_50$nightly_cloud_cover_percent)
noc_50$precip_sc <- scale(noc_50$nightly_precipitation_mm)
noc_50$moon_sc <- scale(noc_50$mean_moonlight)
```



# Examine Precipitation Data

```{r}
#| label: FX-prep-precip-data
Prep_Precip_Data <- function(data, response_col, cloud_col, precip_col) {
  data |>
    select(
      {{ response_col }},
      avg_rad,
      cloud = {{ cloud_col }},
      precip = {{ precip_col }},
      family,
      sp_grid_wk
    ) |>
    mutate(
      cloud_category = case_when(
        cloud == 0 ~ "0%",
        cloud > 0 & cloud <= 25 ~ "1-25%",
        cloud > 25 & cloud <= 50 ~ "26-50%",
        cloud > 50 & cloud <= 75 ~ "51-75%",
        cloud > 75 & cloud <= 100 ~ "76-100%",
        .default = NA_character_
      ),
      cloud_category = factor(
        cloud_category,
        levels = c("0%", "1-25%", "26-50%", "51-75%", "76-100%")
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-create-hist-cloud
Create_Cloud_Hist <- function(data, filename) {
  png(
    here(dir_309_precip, filename),
    width = 800,
    height = 600,
    res = 120
  )

  cloud_hist <- hist(data$cloud)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-print-table1
Print_Table1 <- function(data) {
  table1 <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(cloud_category)) |>
    group_by(cloud_category) |>
    summarise(
      precip_zero = sum(precip == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      precip_gt_zero = sum(precip > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      row_total = n(),
      pct_precip = (precip_gt_zero / row_total) * 100
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -cloud_category,
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = cloud_category,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    mutate(
      `Column total` = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
      Metric = case_when(
        Metric == "precip_zero" ~ "Precip = 0 (n rows)",
        Metric == "precip_gt_zero" ~ "Precip > 0 (n rows)",
        Metric == "row_total" ~ "Row total (sum b and c)",
        Metric == "pct_precip" ~ "% of row with precip ((c / b) * 100)"
      )
    )
  print(table1)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-print-table2
Print_Table2 <- function(data) {
  table2 <- data |>
    summarise(
      `Cloud > 0 & Precip = 0` = sum(cloud > 0 & precip == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Cloud > 0 & Precip > 0` = sum(cloud > 0 & precip > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      `(Cloud = 0 & Precip > 0 — sanity check, should be near 0)` = sum(
        cloud == 0 & precip > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "Category",
      values_to = "n"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      `%` = (n / sum(n)) * 100
    )

  print(table2)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-precip-data
# Onset data
onset_precip <- Prep_Precip_Data(
  diurn_on_50,
  first_onset,
  sunrise_cloud_cover_percent,
  sunrise_precipitation_mm
)

# Cessation data
cess_precip <- Prep_Precip_Data(
  diurn_ev_50,
  ev_ces,
  sunset_cloud_cover_percent,
  sunset_precipitation_mm
)

# Nocturnal data
noc_precip <- Prep_Precip_Data(
  noc_50,
  det,
  nightly_cloud_cover_percent,
  nightly_precipitation_mm
)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-cloud-hist
Create_Cloud_Hist(onset_precip, "309_onset_cloud_hist.png")
Create_Cloud_Hist(cess_precip, "309_cess_cloud_hist.png")
Create_Cloud_Hist(noc_precip, "309_noc_cloud_hist.png")
```

```{r}
#| label: print-table1
# Rows with precipitation
Print_Table1(onset_precip)
Print_Table1(cess_precip)
Print_Table1(noc_precip)
```

```{r}
#| label: print-table2
# Rows with precipitation & clouds
Print_Table2(onset_precip)
Print_Table2(cess_precip)
Print_Table2(noc_precip)
```

# Model precipitation data

## Diurnal onset

```{r}
#| label: onset-precip-all
# All data with precipitation fixed effect (current manuscript)

###Already ran this model in original 305 script
mod_on_50_precip_all <- readRDS(here(dir_305_models, "305c_mod_on_50.rds"))

# Resave anyways for reference
saveRDS(
  mod_on_50_precip_all,
  file = here(dir_309_precip, "309a_mod_on_50_precip_all.rds")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: onset-noprecip-all
# All data with no precipitation fixed effect
#Pull out only columns needed for analysis (frees up R memory):
onset_50_noprecip_all <- diurn_on_50 |>
  dplyr::select(first_onset, cld_sc, alan_sc, family, sp_grid_wk)

#Run the model:
mod_on_50_noprecip_all <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  first_onset ~ 1 +
    cld_sc +
    alan_sc +
    cld_sc:alan_sc +
    (1 + cld_sc + alan_sc | family) +
    (1 | sp_grid_wk),
  data = onset_50_noprecip_all
)

#Save model object:
saveRDS(
  mod_on_50_noprecip_all,
  file = here(dir_309_precip, "309b_mod_on_50_noprecip_all.rds")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: onset-noprecip-exclude
# Data excluding precipitation events with no precipitation fixed effect
#Pull out only columns needed for analysis (frees up R memory):
onset_50_noprecip_exclude <- diurn_on_50 |>
  filter(sunrise_precipitation_mm == 0) |>
  dplyr::select(first_onset, cld_sc, alan_sc, family, sp_grid_wk)

#Run the model:
mod_on_50_noprecip_exclude <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  first_onset ~ 1 +
    cld_sc +
    alan_sc +
    cld_sc:alan_sc +
    (1 + cld_sc + alan_sc | family) +
    (1 | sp_grid_wk),
  data = onset_50_noprecip_exclude
)

#Save model object:
saveRDS(
  mod_on_50_noprecip_exclude,
  file = here(dir_309_precip, "309c_mod_on_50_noprecip_exclude.rds")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-up-onset
rm(mod_on_50_precip_all, onset_50_noprecip_all, mod_on_50_noprecip_all)
rm(mod_on_50_noprecip_exclude, onset_50_noprecip_exclude)
```

## Nocturnal

```{r}
#| label: noc-precip-all
# All data with precipitation fixed effect (current manuscript)

###Already ran this model in original 305 script
mod_noc_50_precip_all <- readRDS(here(
  dir_305_models,
  "305k_mod_noc_50_moon.rds"
))

## Includes 3-way moonlight interaction

# Resave anyways for reference
saveRDS(
  mod_noc_50_precip_all,
  file = here(dir_309_precip, "309g_mod_noc_50_precip_all.rds")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: noc-noprecip-all
# All data with no precipitation fixed effect
#Pull out only columns needed for analysis (frees up R memory):
noc_50_noprecip_all <- noc_50 |>
  dplyr::select(det, cld_sc, alan_sc, moon_sc, common_name, sp_grid_wk)

#Run model
mod_noc_50_noprecip_all <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  det ~ 1 +
    (alan_sc + I(alan_sc^2)) * cld_sc * moon_sc + ### Includes moonlight interaction
    (1 +
      alan_sc +
      I(alan_sc^2) +
      cld_sc +
      alan_sc:cld_sc |
      common_name) +
    (1 | sp_grid_wk),
  family = binomial,
  data = noc_50_noprecip_all
)

#Save model object:
saveRDS(
  mod_noc_50_noprecip_all,
  file = here(dir_309_precip, "309h_mod_noc_50_noprecip_all.rds")
)
```

# Examine precipitation models


```{r}
#| label: set-table-formatting
word_table_args <- list(
  output = "word", #"markdown"
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars} ± {std.error}", #"{estimate} ({std.error})",
  statistic = NULL,
  stars = c('*' = 0.05, '**' = 0.01, '***' = 0.001),
  gof_omit = "ICC|BIC|LogLik|F|RMSE|R2|Cor|SD", # Focus on coefficients
  coef_rename = c(
    "alan_sc" = "Light Pollution (scaled)",
    "cld_sc" = "Cloud Cover (scaled)",
    "precip_sc" = "Precipitation (scaled)",
    "moon_sc" = "Moonlight Intensity (scaled)"
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-precip-models
# Map names to model filenames
file_map <- c(
  "Full Data (+ Precip)" = "309a_mod_on_50_precip_all.rds",
  "Full Data (Unadjusted)" = "309b_mod_on_50_noprecip_all.rds",
  "Subset Data (Excl. Precip)" = "309c_mod_on_50_noprecip_exclude.rds",
  "Full Data (+ Precip)" = "309d_mod_ev_50_precip_all.rds",
  "Full Data (Unadjusted)" = "309e_mod_ev_50_noprecip_all.rds",
  "Subset Data (Excl. Precip)" = "309f_mod_ev_50_noprecip_exclude.rds",
  "Full Data (+ Precip)" = "309g_mod_noc_50_precip_all.rds",
  "Full Data (Unadjusted)" = "309h_mod_noc_50_noprecip_all.rds" #,
  #"Subset Data (Excl. Precip)" = "309i_mod_noc_50_noprecip_exclude.rds"
)

# Read in all model files
all_models <- map(file_map, ~ readRDS(here(dir_309_precip, .x)))

# Group models by response variable
onset_list <- all_models[1:3]
cessation_list <- all_models[4:6]
nocturnal_list <- all_models[7:8] #9]
```

```{r}
#| label: compile-model-summaries
#Diurnal onset models
#do.call(modelsummary, c(list(onset_list), table_args))
do.call(
  modelsummary,
  c(
    list(onset_list, output = here(dir_309_precip, "309_onset_table.docx")),
    word_table_args[-1]
  )
)

#Diurnal cessation models
#do.call(modelsummary, c(list(cessation_list), table_args))
do.call(
  modelsummary,
  c(
    list(cessation_list, output = here(dir_309_precip, "309_cess_table.docx")),
    word_table_args[-1]
  )
)

#Nocturnal models

do.call(
  modelsummary,
  c(
    list(nocturnal_list, output = here(dir_309_precip, "309_noc_table.docx")),

  )
)
```
